module: Console benchmark script: it creates a pickup vehicle with newVehicle():spawn at (0, 0, 0.1), enables BeamEngine.enabled then measures, with HighPerfTimer, the time of 101 simulation steps. Runs on load (test(100)).
notes: Defines the globals v (the vehicle) and hp (the timer, global because there is no local).

test.desc: Runs BeamEngine:update(1/2000, 1/2000) n+1 times (0.5 ms step) and prints the duration of each step in ms.

n.desc: Number of steps, the loop goes from 0 to n inclusive (so n+1 steps).
